author: Mineitup
body:
To me I think that some of the items in the shop are clever but there are not enough of them to use and have clever uses for them. Here are some ideas that I thinkITEMS
A rosebush that has sharpness 2 on it costing 20-25 points
Boots with Feather Falling 4 for 30-40 points pointsA potion of regenoration for 10 points and splash for 15 pointsA fishing rod for 10 pointsA homing arrow for 30 points that it homes in on a player from at least 40 blcks away 
BLOCKS
A pumpkin to wear with aqua Affinity and Respiration 3 for 15 points

You guys can  make-up names in the comments and the best ones could be seen and actually be put into the game

title: New ideas for items in Nexus point shop

replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
The homing arrow sounds really cool, although the others are extremely underpowered. In what case would you need the rose? You already have a sword, no matter what class (and won't  even do as much damage as wood). The feather falling boots would only be good in one map: The Arc. The pumpkin is utterly useless due to the fact that people aren't dumb enough to drown AND it obstructs your vision. The potion of regen isnt actually a bad idea.

So the arrow and the potions are cool, but I think the rest are kinda useless. I mean you could make the pumpkin enchanted with like prot V or something but that's all I can think of.

Kthxbai
